verdict.rationale: Granular roles and view/edit permissions are a fair question for a work-management tool like Trello, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no user roles, board or workspace permission levels, or view-only versus edit controls. The only permission-related items concern API token scopes for app authorization (trello-docs-19) and a casual mention of an easy 'add people' feature, and neither shows a product manager controlling who can view or edit work.
